hub.headline: OpenGL Performer was SGI's toolkit for real-time visual simulation on OpenGL.
hub.next: Write a reference page from the public manuals that explains what Performer did and how it was structured.
hub.what_it_was: OpenGL Performer was an SGI library for real-time visual simulation built on OpenGL, running on IRIX, Linux and Windows. It worked alongside OpenGL and other SGI visualization toolkits and came with sample tools such as Perfly.
hub.what_survives: SGI never released the core libraries. Public PDF copies of the 3.0 Getting Started Guide, the 3.2 Programmer's Guide and a product brochure exist online; the Programmer's Guide carries SGI restriction language, so the archive only links to them.

name: OpenGL Performer
summary: Public records now track OpenGL Performer manuals and SGI feature/interoperability material as public-reference-only documentation anchors.
